description: This file defines the main React component for a Next.js front-end application. It manages uploading documents, orchestrating persona generation, polling backend build status, and rendering UI states for a persona-building workflow.

methods.name: asStringArray
methods.description: Converts an unknown value to a string array, filtering out non-string entries.

methods.name: safeJsonStringify
methods.description: Safely stringifies a value to JSON with formatting, handling errors gracefully.

methods.name: getErrorMessage
methods.description: Extracts a human-readable error message from various error types.

methods.name: isNonEmptyObject
methods.description: Checks if a value is a non-null object with at least one key.

methods.name: getInitials
methods.description: Returns initials for display based on a label string.

methods.name: getNestedOrchestrationValue
methods.description: Safely accesses a nested value in an object using a path array, returning the value and the found path.

methods.name: logAvailableKeys
methods.description: Logs the keys of an object and related nested objects for debugging.

methods.name: extractPersonaJsonFromOrchestrationRecord
methods.description: Extracts persona JSON data from an orchestration record, supporting multiple shape variants.

methods.name: coercePersonaDataFromBackendJson
methods.description: Maps backend JSON shape into the application's PersonaData format.

methods.name: App
methods.description: Main React component that manages persona building workflow, document uploads, backend orchestration, polling, and UI rendering.
